about_pullquote: We move families and businesses like we'd move our own.
about_para_1: Man With Van Removals Handyman has been serving Nottingham for over 15 years. What started as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, built on word-of-mouth from satisfied customers. We've completed thousands of moves — from studio flats to large family homes — always with the same care and attention.
about_para_2: We're here because we believe removals don't have to be stressful or expensive. Our customers come back to us, and they recommend us to their friends, because we show up on time, treat their belongings with respect, and charge fairly. No hidden fees. No faffing about.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the lads move us into our new place in Beeston on a Saturday. Couldn't have asked for better service — they were careful with everything, worked quickly, and even helped us put furniture where we wanted it. Fair price too. Would use again without hesitation.
reviews.author: Claire P.

reviews.text: Booked them for a last-minute house move and they squeezed us in the same week. Two-man team, very professional, got us moved and unpacked in an afternoon. Better than the big national firms and half the cost. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Marcus L.

reviews.text: Came round for a furniture delivery and assembly job. Turned up on time, put the bed together properly, and didn't leave mess everywhere like the last lot. Have already recommended them to my sister. Proper job.
reviews.author: Debbie W.
